suites.title: PB-3 Transfer funds between my own accounts

specs.title: SCN-008: The Transfer Funds page completes a transfer of 1000.00, more than the balance of A

steps.title: Given I am signed in as a newly registered customer who owns accounts A and B
[SEED] customer who owns accounts A and B (register + Open New Account)
And the balance of A is lower than 1000.00
And I am on the Transfer Funds page
When I transfer 1000.00 from A to B
And the balance of A goes negative by the difference
And B is credited with the full amount

specs.title: SCN-009: The REST service refuses an unknown destination account

steps.title: Given a newly registered customer who owns account A
[SEED] customer who owns accounts A and B (register + Open New Account)
And the balance of A is read with GET /accounts/{accountId}
When the service is called with fromAccountId A, toAccountId 99999999 and amount 5.00
And the body is the text "Could not find account number <A> and/or 99999999"
And the balance of A does not change
